help.fetch.title: 1 · Fetch and review
help.fetch.body: Select Recipes or Batches and load the Brewfather list. Select an item or enter its ID. Leave mash-in blank to use the first rest, or enter a temperature. Fetch a preview and check the device name, rests, boil duration, temperature and hop alarms. Read the omitted-data notes, then add the reviewed preview to the upload list. A batch uses its own adjusted recipe. No recipe is sent to the device at this stage.
help.upload.title: 2 · Review the list and upload
help.upload.body: Arrange 1–9 recipes using the arrows and review each device program. Put the Braumeister in its main menu with pump and heater off. Recipe uploads must be enabled in the Bridge. Check readiness. Uploading replaces ALL existing device slots, even when the list contains only one recipe. Only after reviewing the list, tick the confirmation and select Replace all device slots. No brewing program starts automatically.
help.result.title: 3 · Verify the result
help.result.body: The bottom of the card shows the job and confirmed slots. Recipe count confirmed only confirms the number. Content verified by readback confirms a matching device recipe list. Pending verification means no readback is available yet; a mismatch means you must check the device. You can request job status again without resending recipes. Also check the recipe selection on the Braumeister. If the outcome is unknown, do not blindly upload again. Unlock only after manually checking the device and Bridge and confirming no job is running.
help.setup.title: Setup and troubleshooting
help.setup.body: Register {resource} as a JavaScript module under Settings → Dashboards → Resources, then reload the browser. This loads both the operating card and this help card. Brewfather needs recipes.read and batches.read. Store credentials in the HBAC integration, never in dashboard YAML. The Bridge needs the three upload actions from PR #30. With several HBAC entries, set entry_id in each operating card; use the HBAC configuration ID from the upload sensor attribute, not the device ID. Integration updates require an HA restart; a new integration with UI setup can load immediately in Marketplace.

help.sources.title: Additional recipe sources
help.sources.body: Add a Brewer’s Friend API key through HBAC reconfiguration, then select Brewer’s Friend and load the list or enter a recipe ID. For BeerXML, upload a file or select an XML file from the configured HA folder (default /config/hbac/import). Create that folder yourself if needed. Files stay unchanged. Select one recipe, preview it and add it to the shared list; repeat for other recipes. Imports never start a device upload. BeerXML uses standard Celsius and minute fields; unsupported steps or fractional device values are rejected.
